newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds run out of steam, 109-14 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds run out of steam, 109-14 support.

text.p: June T-bond futures have started to flag after their recent spurt higher but would find initial support at 109-14 on Wednesday, technical analysts said.

"The market is losing a little bit of steam," Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, said. "It's not extremely negative but it needs to move higher today or we'll take a point back."
Hobson favoured the downside but said initial support would come in at 109-14. Daily charts show this as the low on May 2.
T-bonds were quoted at 109-31 at 0828 GMT, down 4/32 in automated trade.
"Support of significance comes in at 108-30 and huge support at 108-08," Hoboson said.
Daily charts show the contract topping out at 108-30 on April 29 before shooting higher. A range top comes in around 108-08 from the end of April.

"We've had a plus three (point) range last week and that only occurs four to six times a year and nine times out of 10 over the last two or three years those weekly ranges have been followed by consolidation," Hobson said.
He said resistance on Wednesday would come in around the 110-05,02 level.
He said 110-02 was a 38.2 percent retracement of the December to April decline while 110-05 was a 50 percent retracement of the February to April drop.
Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London, also said the market looked constrained.
"We're just seeing a drift down," she said. "It's overbought on the RSI. Really there's quite a lot of resistance coming in between 110-00 and 110-14, which is the March 7 high."
She said that was also just above 50 percent of the February to April fall. "Very short term it looks as though it will have a look at yesterday's low which is around 109-21."
